confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Ipoh and Malaysian price levels. Not checked against live menus, booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because rates vary with season, weekends and listing type. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local price relationship to beer, since direct knowledge of Ipoh bar prices is weak. The FX value (0.6955 for 2026-10-15) comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates page. I did not open the RBA page directly, and a later 16 October figure from a third-party site could not be confirmed on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Malaysian cities priced below Kuala Lumpur and Penang, with Ipoh's food-centred local restaurant scene as the main reference point. No single named comparable city was used.
